lines.text: It can be a kind word,
Different animals leave different footprints in the snow.
Can you match them to the right animal?
It's a bright and snowy day and the Giggle Dumplings
discover mysterious footprints in the fresh snow.
Together they follow the trail through the forest,
across frozen streams and up to a little hill.
What will they find at the end of the footprints?
It can be a thank you,
Even a small message can make someone smile,
and a smile can brighten their whole day!
Kindness helps friends, families and communities
It's February and the Giggle Dumplings spread
friendship notes throughout the snowy village.
Mail Carrier Bao delivers four special letters to
different mailboxes. Following the last note, they
cross the old stone bridge-and there it is:
Two stars sparkle now, and the Dumplings wonder:
what other adventures are still waiting?
It can be a flower, a herb
or even just a small seed
Did you know? Seeds can travel in many ways - by wind, by water,
by animals or even on people's shoes!
Healthy plants make clean air, provide food for animals
and create colorful places for everyone to enjoy.
In March, spring arrives in the village and the Giggle
Dumplings want to plant seeds in the garden. Gardener Bao
notices a little trail of seeds on the ground. Curious, he
follows the trail through the village and fields.
At the old tree, he makes a surprising discovery - the trail
led to a third shining star! But then Bao realizes the reason
for the missing seeds: his own seed bag has a small hole!
Even small mistakes can lead to wonderful adventures!

Butterflies help flowers grow by carrying pollen.
They need clean air, colorful meadows and many different plants
Together we can make a big difference -
for the butterflies, for the animals and for our future!
In May, the Giggle Dumplings follow a trail of beautiful
butterflies through the blooming meadows to a very old tree
at the edge of the forest. Inside the tree hollow, they find
The butterflies show them that nature is full of
little wonders. Where will the next adventure lead?
Picnics are a great way to enjoy nature.
Please always leave the place clean for others!
In June, the Giggle Dumplings plan a picnic in the meadows.
But when they arrive, their strawberries are missing!
Can they find out who took them?

Did you know? Wet sand sticks together much better than dry sand
That's why it's perfect for building sandcastles!
In July, the Giggle Dumplings build a giant sandcastle at the beach.
While digging a new tower, they discover a sparkling star!
Can you find where the star was hidden?
Did you know? Fireflies are not just pretty - they are actually beetles!
They light up using a special chemical reaction in their bodies.
On a warm summer night, the Giggle Dumplings take a
walk through the forest. Fireflies show them the way

Many ancient ruins are hundreds or even thousands of years old.
Archaeologists carefully dig and clean to learn more about how people lived long ago.
In September, the Giggle Dumplings explore ancient ruins.
They find a mysterious stone circle with twelve star-shaped spaces
Pumpkins are actually a type of berry!
They can be orange, yellow, white, green or even striped.
In October, the Giggle Dumplings visit a pumpkin farm.
They discover a tiny door in a huge pumpkin
Did you know? Storms can be very strong and move trees, leaves and even whole branches.
After a storm, animals often find new places to live and new things are discovered in the forest.
In November, a big storm sweeps through the forest.
After the wind calms down, the Giggle Dumplings discover a clue
under an uprooted tree and find the eleventh star!
In December, the Giggle Dumplings find the twelfth and last star.
All twelve stars open the gate to the magical Giggle House.
As the night falls, the five friends watch a beautiful silver firework
light up the sky. Their adventure was just the beginning ...
